goal: Metals, Gems, User, Heads, Finger, Cutting, Creation palette
negative_oracle: Duplicate display label must not cause ID collision

behaviour_reference.source: OM9_Milestones/M01 - CAD Shell, Viewport/L2-03-14 - Febe Matrix Layers Objectinfo Superselect/reference/text/m8book1__p54-57__the-layers-menu.md
behaviour_reference.quote: grouping colors into four: "Metals", "Gems", "User" colors, and layer colors on which the parts are typically created by Matrix builders ("Heads", "Finger" or ring size, "Cutting", and "Creation")
behaviour_reference.decision: The manual gives four groups and names the four builder colours; the plan asks the palette for seven categories. Both are kept: PaletteGroup (4) and LayerCategory (7), with the builder group carrying Heads/Finger/Cutting/Creation.

method: The behavioural source for this L3 is the extracted Matrix9 manual section shipped with the milestone (reference/), not QymCAD: the palette is a Matrix interface. QymCAD is consulted only for the UI technique of a colour palette.

planned_anchors.what_is_missing: QymCAD has no layer palette and no colour category: it is consulted only for how a panel paints rows.

implemented_api_before_this_task: om9-core/src/layers/preset.rs: PresetSlot 1..=33 with fixed names and colours (Metal 01-04, Gem 01-04, User 01-04, Heads, Finger, Cutting, Creation, 16 custom colours, Lights), label validation and serde as u8
om9-app/src/layer_command.rs: group(slot) returned the 4-row VISUAL block of a slot (13..=16 for the builder row) and CMD parsing by number/name with ambiguity refusal
om9-app/src/ui/layers.rs: the palette painted two columns of 4-row blocks with group toggles, name/swatch/lock/visibility controls and the current-layer highlight
gap_found_by_this_task: There was no semantic category at all: the palette drew anonymous 4-row blocks, so the seven names the plan and the manual use (Metals/Gems/User/Heads/Finger/Cutting/Creation) existed nowhere in code or on screen.
The manual's FOUR groups were not modelled either: group(slot) is a visual block, not a group, and the four builder colours were indistinguishable from the Metals/Gems/User blocks.

Added: layers/category.rs (PaletteGroup with the manual's four groups, LayerCategory with the plan's seven, slot→category for 1..=33 including the custom colours 17..=32 as User and 33 Lights as uncategorised), PresetSlot::category/palette_group/category_label, the category label painted on every palette row, and the palette block in the audit receipt (palette.categories + palette.slots) so a real window can prove it.

Identity stayed the slot number: a renamed custom row shows its own text but is still slot 17, and a custom slot may not take a reserved label (preset::valid_label), so a duplicate display label cannot collide with a preset id.
reuse_decision: ADD the semantic categories over the existing PresetSlot model; the palette technique stays in ui/layers.rs.
